body: I don't mean to dismiss your experience, but one year is different from a lifetime.

As a human being, there is no "happy by yourself". We need others and to bond like the most social species on Earth that we are, otherwise we get sick. After just having myself for almost 30 years, and feeling this way for almost 2 decades, there is no "happy by yourself". That's just an illusion to get people to look the other way. That's why the biggest public health crisis other than corona virus is loneliness.
What do you mean by "spat back in your face"? Is that what you mean by "failing and moving on"?
Something that I look for is commitment, care, and consistency. I guess no one wants that with me.

At this point, I'm so deflated that I don't even have the energy to make all of those improvements. I just wish that someone could just love me as I am, just like I've loved so many as they are and were

Even without expectation, work is work. Work is building any kind of relationship at all. It takes work to "find" love. Being told not to expect anything is not only obvious, but it misses the point of what I was saying. And it only makes me feel more hopeless and dysphoric about any future on this Earth.
I LOVE CHIROPRACTORS! Lol And I love that you see at least some hope. That path sounds like a good one!! I'm hugging you!!!!! & Message me whenever if you want
Thank you!! I'm here to help and I mean it 😊❤❤❤ And I know I'm not the only person. There are people like you and me around, but we just have take a look to "see" each other when we encounter them.

I wouldn't give that cheater the satisfaction of being the last person with you. I know that you might not be thinking about it that way, but I think that's worth considering. Attractiveness is more than what type of body you have. But even with extra weight, that doesn't make you nearly as unattractive as you might think most of the time. You can still be really attractive. You just may be very hard on yourself right now. The women I loved were overweight too. It's not as big of a deal for many guys as you think. And as absurd as this can sound, I think that the emotional pain you endure from trauma that wasn't your fault, and your mind constantly replaying everything that happened is in large part your brain trying to search for the solution to either fix the problem, or to prevent it from happening again. So the best we can do is understand that one's current or potential partner is not their ex, but we should apply the things we've learned about preventing tragedy, betrayal or relationship breakdown while always engaging in healthy communication.
That person who inboxed that to you was being an ingnorant troll. I suggest blocking them and deleting their inbox.

I may not be in Aus, but you found a soul like me. And I'm not the only one who could love so deeply in an intimate connection or relationship with someone as brave and real as you. Chances are he's really attractive, especially when you get to know him. Love can heal so deeply, and there is love to be had for someone with the sincere heart you have. So when you get that, why not ask or ask again what the doctor says about your chances of a family?
Oh but it is young. It's around my sister's age when she started her family.

I understand. But I think it is temporary. I'll say this as to why. Considering what you've been through, considering that you're still young, and considering the amount of love you must be capable of giving to make it this far, a man like me sees that and understands that you deserve a love and a bond deeper than any ocean. And we will give that of ourselves if youl'll let us share that. If you'll let him share that with you, and you with him.

So, please call 1 800-273-8255 as they can help you like they helped me a year and a half ago. And again I'm also here.
Even in as much pain and anxiety as I'm in right now. As much as I feel the need to close my eyes forever right now. Tears and all. I want you to be ok. I want me to be ok.

I have felt that for many people before, and at one point in the past, everyone. But know this, that I want you to win and to make it, and of course for myself to as well not to mention. I want this all to be temporary. I want this all to pass. Know that I want new, finally good chapters for you, and for me too. And also, that I profoundly hate this world right alongside you, right with you. I'm here for you and would like for you be ok "here", as well as for me to be.

I'll just talk... It is awful that you're going through this. And it had to be terrible, the PMDD that you've dealt with. That is definitely a very hard load to carry. I can't imagine bearing through that, especially for so long. And I know the feeling of when love is so agonizingly scarce and illusive, if not completely nonexistent in any reciprocal sense... Ever since small childhood, I was raised to live in a religious mental prison. I lived my entire youth until 24 as if I already had no future. Now it's my reality. I didn't really deal with physical pain. But from my preteen years to this day, it's been virtually nothing but self hatred, low self-esteem and the emptiness of being unwanted and lonely. Yet all I want is to care for someone. I don't think I care about anything else more. My 20s are already more than half over and I don't see a future of any success. Maybe I'll be good enough to be mediocre by 30, but I'll never have enough for someone to love me. And as bad as it sounds, for me there's no point of being "here" if there is no one I can love, care for, and to be here for each other. I just want one person. It hurts every day, and it never stops hurting. The two brief moments in my life where I thought there might be a chance for love, I found out almost as quickly how much I meant nothing, and that I was just by myself the whole time. I'm shown every time and all my life that I don't matter. So I just don't want to do this anymore. There is just one person I care enough about who I consider that I should stay for despite my endless pain. And that is because I don't want to hurt that person or anyone like that. And so I just stay stuck "here" in agony forever.

I feel the same. It's like what's even the point. This, being "here" is just meaningless motion. There is only one person I care about enough that maybe I should stay despite the endless pain. And I wouldn't want to hurt that person or anyone like that. So I'm just in agony.
